description: Adds 14% NS HST to a subtotal, or splits a tax-included total. Confirm the rate with CRA. Returns { subtotalCents, hstCents, totalCents, rate }. Price: 1 credit (1 credit = 1 CAD cent) per successful call; input that does not match the schema is rejected before billing.

amountCents.description: Pre-tax subtotal, or the tax-included total when included is true. Integer CAD cents.

included.description: amountCents already includes HST: split it instead of adding to it.

rate.description: HST rate as a fraction (0.14 is the Nova Scotia rate).

name: hst-calc
title: Nova Scotia HST calculator
